shape: Dense 2-portal arena (N+E gates with center-hub + perimeter detours)
description: Two-portal arena with a high-degree center anchor (argr4m) that connects to most other anchors. The north entry hub (jp2ewj) and east entry hub (yrnqot) both fan into the interior. A south-row cluster (yg9ndg + qhtsec + reko3w) covers the south half, with corner detours at SW (5jg4v4) and far-west (bb6kit). The east hub also has a small north-pocket detour (4o60z8).

portals.north: spawn_north at (-16.91, -15.59) — gate on the NW side
portals.east: spawn_east at (23.10, -17.11) — gate on the east side, north half

traversalNotes: Direct N↔E: spawn_north → north_inner → center → east_inner → spawn_east. 4 hops via center.
Alternative N↔E: north_inner → north_mid → east_inner. Also 4 hops.
DISPATCH RULE: center is the canonical dispatch anchor — reaches south_center, east_mid, south_east, sw_corner, west_pocket. Use center for cross-zone objective dispatch.
Two dead-end pockets (north_pocket, west_pocket / sw_corner) for objective detours.
